oneLine: Atomberg allots Rs 150 crore for marketing in a proposed IPO.

sources.title: Atomberg allots Rs 150 crore for performance marketing in proposed IPO

synopsis: Atomberg Technologies has received clearance from the Securities and Exchange Board of India for its proposed initial public offering. The IPO comprises a fresh issue of equity shares aggregating up to Rs 450 crore and an offer for sale of approximately 7.65 crore equity shares by existing investors. The company plans to allocate Rs 150 crore from the fresh issue proceeds towards brand awareness and performance marketing. The IPO price band and subscription dates have not yet been announced.
